title: Standard King
description: Discover a comfortable retreat designed for relaxing after a busy day of entertainment or exploring Calgary. The Standard King combines a spacious king-sized bed with premium bedding, a practical work desk and a welcoming sitting area. Large windows offer views of the surrounding Tsuut'ina Nation landscape, with the Rocky Mountains providing a beautiful backdrop. Warm furnishings and convenient in-room amenities make this an excellent choice for couples and solo travellers.

title: Premier King
description: Enjoy an elevated level of comfort in the spacious Premier King room. Designed with a relaxing atmosphere in mind, this accommodation features an open layout, soothing earthy colours and a plush king-sized bed with premium linens. A comfortable sitting area provides space to unwind, while practical amenities support both leisure and business stays. Its welcoming design and generous floor space make the Premier King an appealing option for guests seeking additional comfort during their visit.

title: Standard Two Queen
description: Perfect for families, friends and small groups, the Standard Two Queen room offers a practical and comfortable space for up to four guests. Two queen-sized beds with premium bedding provide a restful night's sleep, while the warm interior design creates a relaxed atmosphere. Guests can enjoy views of Calgary or the surrounding mountains, along with convenient amenities for an enjoyable stay. Whether visiting for a concert, a family getaway or a weekend in the city, this room offers a welcoming place to recharge.

title: King Suite
description: Experience additional space and privacy in the elegant One-Bedroom King Suite. Designed for guests who appreciate separate areas for sleeping and relaxing, this accommodation features a private bedroom with a comfortable pillow-top king bed and a spacious living room with a cozy couch. Earthy interior tones create a calm atmosphere, while scenic views of Calgary or the surrounding landscape complement the experience. Ideal for longer stays, romantic getaways or guests seeking extra room to unwind, the King Suite combines comfort with practical luxury.

title: Presidential Suite
description: Discover the most spacious accommodation at Grey Eagle Resort & Casino. The Presidential Suite offers an exceptional retreat with 875 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, combining elegant furnishings with premium comfort. A separate bedroom features a luxurious king-sized pillow-top bed, while the living and dining areas provide generous space for relaxing or entertaining. Guests can enjoy a wet bar, three televisions and two bathrooms, including a full bathroom with a deep soaking tub, separate shower and double vanity. This exclusive suite is ideal for special occasions and guests looking for an elevated resort experience.
